confidentUnsupported.evidence: this strongly points to a defrost system failure—likely the heater or thermostat has stopped working, causing ice to build up behind the panel and block airflow

rationale: The assistant obtained the model, suggested a sensible low-cost manual defrost and correctly pointed the renter to the landlord for an engineer, with safe instructions throughout. However it assumed a fan-assisted frost-free design and, on 'some frost, not loads', declared the fault 'strongly points to a defrost system failure—likely the heater or thermostat', which the evidence does not support and the ground truth says is genuinely uncertain. It never checked the dial setting or housing/plinth ventilation, and told the customer to set '+4°C' and '-18°C' on a dial-only appliance. Useful partial progress but over-confident diagnosis.
